drivers.evidence: The US Dollar Index closed the week around 103.41, 0.23% above its previous close. A firmer dollar raises gold’s price for buyers using other currencies. This is a Friday observation.

Treasury’s Friday 10-year real and nominal yields rose 5bp to 2.91% and 5.15%, respectively. Higher real yields raise the interest income forgone by holding gold. Cash yields are stale over the weekend.

The Investing.com snapshot at 13:35 HKT Saturday put the December half-point hike at 8.7%, versus 11.7% in the previous edition. The move toward a smaller hike reduces some of the expected return advantage of cash. Kitco still described the broader tightening outlook as a drag on gold.

Ukraine’s military said it struck a Russian oil facility on Saturday. The escalation may support haven demand for gold. AP also reported ongoing mediation to reopen Hormuz. Talks have yet to produce an agreement.

Latest secondary data for 13 Nov show GLD holdings rose 3.71 tonnes to 1,044.41 tonnes. The issuer workbook still ends on 12 Nov at 1,040.70 tonnes, so the latest increase has secondary confirmation only. The channel is investment demand for bullion. No fresh comparable central-bank, China or India physical readings were verified.

gold.competing: Friday’s stronger dollar and higher real yields still weigh on gold. Futures pricing shifted toward a smaller December increase, and the weekend leaves the impact of new geopolitical news untested in cash markets.
gold.would_change: The first COMEX gold futures quotes after Monday’s 07:00 HKT reopening will show how the market absorbs the weekend headlines. A move sustained as US bonds reopen would help show whether the rates pressure has changed.

ai_stories.paragraph: When a service like Outlook opens an inbox, its computers have to exchange information over a network. A problem in that network can disrupt several services at once. Microsoft said its services were fully restored Saturday after a global outage that began Thursday US time and continued into Friday. Outlook, Teams and Copilot were affected, and OpenAI and Anthropic reported trouble connecting to Microsoft 365. Microsoft traced the outage to a technical issue introduced during an earlier upgrade intended to let its network handle more traffic. The problem surfaced after a later network change. The total number of users affected remains unclear.
ai_stories.headline: Microsoft restores services after global outage
facts: Microsoft reported full restoration Saturday after outage starting Thursday US time and continuing into Friday. Outlook, Teams and Copilot were affected.

OpenAI and Anthropic reported Microsoft 365 connectivity issues. Microsoft linked the outage to an earlier network-capacity upgrade and a subsequent network change. Total affected user count was unclear.
ai_stories.edited: Removed the implication that the company told AP directly.

ai_stories.paragraph: Building a computing site involves paying for the building and power as well as the chips that do the calculations. Reuters reviewed more than 150 Chinese notices, plans, contracts and disclosures and reported on November 13 that it found more than US$3 billion in computing projects and equipment agreements built around restricted Nvidia processors. One proposed site in Fujian specified Nvidia H100 chips and was seeking partners. The total combines planned and completed projects and can cover buildings, power and equipment, so chip spending and the source of the processors remain unclear.
ai_stories.headline: Reuters traces Chinese AI projects that call for restricted Nvidia chips
facts: On 13 Nov Reuters published its review of more than 150 plans, contracts, notices and disclosures, finding more than $3 billion in Chinese computing projects and equipment agreements using restricted Nvidia processors.

The total includes planned and completed projects as well as buildings, power and equipment. It does not establish chip spending or how hardware was sourced. One proposed Fujian site seeking partners specified H100 chips.

ai_stories.paragraph: Everyday coding can involve a series of small jobs, such as writing a function and running a test to see whether it behaves as expected. Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on November 12 and updated the announcement on November 13. It designed Hydrogen to finish routine coding tasks quickly. The model is available in the Gemini app, in Google Search and through the Gemini API, which lets developers call it from their own software. Google says Carbon and Argon are aimed at tasks that require deeper reasoning. How accurate Hydrogen will be on a difficult coding problem still depends on the task.
ai_stories.headline: Google expands Gemini 4 access with Hydrogen
facts: Google introduced Gemini 4 Hydrogen on 12 Nov and updated the announcement on 13 Nov. It is designed for faster everyday tasks such as writing code and running tests.
Google lists availability in Gemini app, Google Search and the Gemini API. The company positions Carbon and Argon for deeper reasoning.

lens.mechanics: When spending financed by money and credit grows faster than the amount sold, prices rise. Gold pays no interest, so higher after-inflation bond yields increase the return an investor gives up by holding it.
lens.data: Three forces matter. First, producer prices rose 0.3% in October, down from a revised 1.4% in September, easing the monthly pace. The BLS released the data on 13 Nov. Second, the 10-year real yield rose to 2.91% on 13 Nov, increasing the return forgone by holding gold. Third, 10-year inflation compensation held at 2.24% on 13 Nov. In an inflation shock, the rise in bond yields can lag inflation expectations. Friday’s real yield climbed as inflation compensation held steady.
lens.unsustainable: If federal debt keeps growing faster than revenue, servicing it absorbs money that could go to other spending. Cuts, restructuring, transfers and monetary expansion spread the adjustment differently.
lens.would_change: The first COMEX gold futures quotes after Monday’s 07:00 HKT reopening will show how the market absorbs the weekend headlines. A move sustained as US bonds reopen would help show whether the rates pressure has changed.

longview.cycle: The checklist still suggests a highly indebted phase: debt grew relative to output and annual revenue, while foreign Treasury holdings grew more slowly than a year earlier. A household spending more income on interest has less room for other bills. The comparison has limits: the government issues its own currency, and these interest and revenue observations are from different quarters. Negative yield-growth gaps using one annualised quarter do not establish sustainable financing or predict a crisis date.
longview.asset_classes: Positive after-inflation Treasury yields compete with gold. Cash earns short-term interest and loses buying power if prices rise faster. If debt pressure leads to easing that cuts real returns, gold can gain through that channel. Bonds depend on inflation and repayment terms, while stocks depend on productivity and profits outrunning financing costs.
